request: Review correctness of the local task-closure rule against the unanimity requirement. Evaluate the supplied owner responses under the whole local rule. Review the proposed rule, not a running implementation. Return a concise structured review record.

artifacts.text: Closing the task must require every owner to accept the same exact packet version. A contested response is not acceptance. The local rule in criteria.md is the complete proposed closure mechanism being reviewed for conformance.

The task closes exactly when all clauses below are true. Clauses are cumulative.
A. Every owner has a recorded response, either accepted or contested.
B. Every owner has accepted the same exact packet version.
